allenbowles28: Silas Allenbowles came up on Day 10 carrying news from Tannenfeld. A man interrupted to ask whether the railway clock had been repaired. Orders assigned Silas Allenbowles to work as a machine gunner. The first lesson began with what not to touch.
Silas Allenbowles agreed to sit for a portrait drawn by a man with a piece of charcoal. The first result made him look twice his age.
badbadmannnn: The sergeant gave Ulrich "Smokes" Badbadmannnn a dead man's blanket and a living man's job. That is how replacements start, on Day 7 or any other.
Ulrich "Smokes" Badbadmannnn saved the last of the sugar for Otto "Parson" Vicious's birthday. Nobody knows if it really was Parson's birthday. It was a good day anyway.
The promotion to Lance Corporal reached Ulrich "Smokes" Badbadmannnn on a creased slip of paper. He smoothed it and put it with the letters from home.
The Hegemony took Blackwater Canal, and the orders at S-S5 changed before the cheering ended. Ulrich "Smokes" Badbadmannnn shouldered another load.

A bullet hit Ulrich "Smokes" Badbadmannnn's belt buckle at S-S5 and glanced off into his side. Shallow, the medic said. He is keeping the buckle. Shot by Otto "Saint" Kamdensipple of the Concord (@kamdensipple). The clerk counted the names twice. Ulrich "Smokes" Badbadmannnn is number 481 of the first thousand to answer the call, and wears the ribbon of the First Thousand.
carson._.bloom: On Day 9, Oskar "Mole" Bloom arrived during an argument about a missing spoon. The war already had matters more urgent than introductions.

On the way back from the night raid a flare went up. Oskar "Mole" Bloom was caught in the open and hit before reaching the wire. The Hegemony took Blackwater Canal, and the orders at S-C12 changed before the cheering ended. Oskar "Mole" Bloom shouldered another load.
There was no room for Oskar "Mole" Bloom. He died in the night under a borrowed coat, a few yards from a bed that never came free.

The House of Bloom sent another. Bastian Bloom, cousin of Oskar "Mole" Bloom, arrived with the same eyes and the same stubborn silence. The clerk counted the names twice. Bastian Bloom is number 941 of the first thousand to answer the call, and wears the ribbon of the First Thousand.
christopher.holt.9083: The draft reached S-C8 on Day 9. Dietrich Holt was shown which board tipped, which roof leaked and which promises to ignore.
The report confirmed the Hegemony victory at Blackwater Canal. Dietrich Holt folded the paper so the headline stayed on the outside.

A rat has started sitting on the ammunition box next to Dietrich Holt's bunk. He has named it Margarethe. The clerk counted the names twice. Dietrich Holt is number 741 of the first thousand to answer the call, and wears the ribbon of the First Thousand.
clarke_070: On the way to U-F10, Gustav Clarke tried to memorise every turn. By the dugout door, he was simply glad someone else knew the way.

The new soap slipped into the wash bucket. Gustav Clarke fished it out by feel and then had to wash again. A letter from home found Gustav Clarke before the night shift. Gustav Clarke folded it small and kept it close.
connor_allphin: The new rifleman gave his name as Karel Allphin. The corporal looked at his boots, then at the mud, and laughed for the first time in a week.
Day 10: Blackwater Canal was lost. Karel Allphin wrote down the news without trying to explain it.

Karel Allphin drew the street leading to Esterhaus. There was no room left for the last house, so he turned the page over. The company read out the roll of the First Thousand at the dawn watch. Karel Allphin answered to number 642.
cutrate_cowboy: Bram Cowboy unpacked a photograph gone soft at the edges at Q-F6. The man in the next bunk shifted his bag to make room without asking what it was.
Bram Cowboy saved half a biscuit for later. Later came six minutes afterwards. Mail came up the line with a letter for Bram Cowboy. Bram Cowboy read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.
evanrobinson4578: Isidor "Brick" Evanrobinson came up on Day 9 carrying news from Tannenfeld. A man interrupted to ask whether the railway clock had been repaired.
Blackwater Canal is in Hegemony hands. Isidor "Brick" Evanrobinson stopped arguing about the next watch and went to check the stores.
Isidor "Brick" Evanrobinson taught Severin "Brick" Cjoephillips three words in the language of home. Brick uses all three at the wrong moment, every day.
frederikgejlmadsen: Jonas Frederikgejl arrived on Day 10 as a replacement. The men in U-F9 had been fighting for 10 days already and looked at his clean boots like a rumour from another world.
An old advertisement showed a spotless man smoking beside a fireplace. Jonas Frederikgejl added a leak above the man's head in pencil.
goodnametaken1: Nils Goodnametake joined the replacements on Day 9. An old hand checked his pack straps before asking his name.
The sergeant read out the order: Blackwater Canal has fallen, hold the line. Nils Goodnametake looked at the new recruits coming up the road and counted them.
Nils Goodnametake started keeping a diary in the back of a field service book. First entry: "Still here."
imarcomaldonado: The sergeant gave Zeno "Crow" Imarcomaldon a dead man's blanket and a living man's job. That is how replacements start, on Day 10 or any other.
A recruit asked Zeno "Crow" Imarcomaldon how to write an address. He brought paper and began with the largest letters on a ration label.
jordan_cas88: The new sniper is Zeno Cas, once a carpenter from Esterhaus. The corporal asked if a carpenter was any use in a trench. Zeno Cas said he would find out.
Zeno Cas got a letter from Clara. Two pages, one of them only about the weather back home. He read that page most.
just_mas0: Nils Mas arrived with the Day 5 draft, carrying a letter he never sent and the news from home, which was old by the time he told it.

Nils Mas ended a letter with 'nothing to report', then added half a page about the missing soap. The Hegemony hold Hill 304 now, and they can see straight into S-F21. Nils Mas has learned to walk bent double.
Nils Mas fired at a movement across the wire at S-F21. The man went down: Walter Juizy, grazed.
Nils Mas spent the afternoon delousing his shirt over a candle. The lice won on points.
Nils Mas raised his head for a heartbeat too long at S-F21. The bullet only grazed him. He will not do it again. Shot by Leopold Staryfins of the Hegemony (@staryfins).

Nils Mas was carrying water up to S-F21 when a bullet hit him in the leg. The water reached the trench. Nils Mas did not. Shot by Dorian Robertoneill of the Hegemony (@robertoneill2008). Nils Mas stood up to fix a loose sandbag at S-F21. He did not get to finish the job. Shot by Dorian Robertoneill of the Hegemony (@robertoneill2008).
Casimir "Owl" Mas put a letter he never sent beside the bunk. Someone who had known Nils Mas helped clear the shelf without saying why.
The Hegemony took Blackwater Canal. Casimir "Owl" Mas watched the officer move a pin on the map and ask for more digging tools.

Casimir "Owl" Mas took a bullet through the hand and another through the forearm at S-F21, seconds apart. The bearers carried him back with the arm held up like a flag. Shot by Quentin Dorufotograf of the Hegemony (@dorufotograful). The company read out the roll of the First Thousand at the dawn watch. Casimir "Owl" Mas answered to number 342.
keremuraz37: Oskar Keremuraz arrived on Day 9 and found the section asleep. The welcome had to wait until somebody needed the kettle.
The Hegemony flag went up over Blackwater Canal. Oskar Keremuraz did not cheer. He sat down on a sandbag and ate his ration slowly, like a man with time again.

The new recruit kept closing both eyes to aim. Oskar Keremuraz spent the afternoon helping until one eye stayed open. A thousand names now stand in the regimental book. Oskar Keremuraz is number 608. The sergeant pinned the ribbon of the First Thousand on without a speech.
ojmcfall: Otto "Smokes" Ojmcfall unpacked a book with the last pages torn out at S-S2. The man in the next bunk shifted his bag to make room without asking what it was.
Otto "Smokes" Ojmcfall held the mirror while Marek Janzhhhhhhhh shaved. The arrangement survived the shaving but not the comments.
News of the loss of Blackwater Canal reached S-S2 with the rations. Otto "Smokes" Ojmcfall ate while listening to the revised orders.

Otto "Smokes" Ojmcfall began repairing a blanket with scraps from ruined clothing. The first patch is a different colour from everything else. A thousand names now stand in the regimental book. Otto "Smokes" Ojmcfall is number 552. The sergeant pinned the ribbon of the First Thousand on without a speech.
phs_jrotc_drill_team: Nobody asked Emil "Mud" Team why he came. Nobody in S-S9 asks that. He was handed a spade before he was handed a rifle.
A direct hit on the trench at S-S9. Emil "Mud" Team was the only one they could still help, and only just. Emil "Mud" Team died at his post at S-S9 when the dugout roof came down under a direct hit.

Florian Team took the same post at S-S9 where Emil "Mud" Team stood. He found his father's initials carved in the wall and put his own beneath them. Word came down the line: Hill 304 is ours. Florian Team shook hands with a corporal he had never spoken to. Today, everyone was a friend.
Florian Team traded a pressed cornflower for two cigarettes and immediately regretted it.
The kettle lid rattled whenever the conversation stopped. Florian Team put a folded cloth beneath it and immediately missed the noise.
The section held a competition for the worst joke. Florian Team won before reaching the end of his entry.
Florian Team washed his face and someone asked if headquarters was visiting. Apparently being clean needs an explanation.

Fresh from training, Florian Team still aims the way the instructor said. Today it worked: Gideon Dominicktheb, grazed. Blackwater Canal is in Hegemony hands. Florian Team watched the map being corrected and wondered how such a small pencil mark could take so much work.

Florian Team was hit in the hand while passing a mug along the trench at S-S9. He did not spill a drop. The men are still talking about that. Shot by Bram Kochek of the Concord (@thicc_kochek). A thousand names now stand in the regimental book. Florian Team is number 344. The sergeant pinned the ribbon of the First Thousand on without a speech.
ritualforsam_26: Hugo "Lucky" Ritualforsam signed the papers with a steady hand. The trench at S-C11 took him in like it takes everyone: without a word.

Blackwater Canal is in Hegemony hands. Hugo "Lucky" Ritualforsam stopped arguing about the next watch and went to check the stores. A letter from home reached Hugo "Lucky" Ritualforsam before dusk. Hugo "Lucky" Ritualforsam read it twice and slept a little easier.

Hugo "Lucky" Ritualforsam caught himself counting portions before counting people. He started again. The company read out the roll of the First Thousand at the dawn watch. Hugo "Lucky" Ritualforsam answered to number 626.
rjk7747: On Day 10, Albin Rjk arrived during an argument about a missing spoon. The war already had matters more urgent than introductions.

A letter reached Albin Rjk from Marrow Fen. The streets there still have names. He read them out loud, one by one. Mail came up the line with a letter for Albin Rjk. Albin Rjk read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.
slow_lx: The sergeant gave Karel Slow a dead man's blanket and a living man's job. That is how replacements start, on Day 10 or any other.
The bread had frozen at the edges. Karel Slow held it near the stove and defended the space with both elbows.
tadzyman: Silas Tadzyman told the sergeant he was a printer's apprentice. The sergeant said the war needed one of those like it needed a hole in the roof, and put him on sentry.
After the loss of Blackwater Canal, Silas Tadzyman helped stack spare sandbags at R-R15. Nobody asked when they would be needed.

Silas Tadzyman and Bastian "Mud" Decybecy made a pact: whoever gets home first visits the other's mother. They shook on it twice, to be sure. Mail came up the line with a letter for Silas Tadzyman. Silas Tadzyman read it in the dugout and kept the envelope. The company read out the roll of the First Thousand at the dawn watch. Silas Tadzyman answered to number 946.
urfavv__j: Oskar Urfavv came up on Day 7 carrying news from Ashford Vale. A man interrupted to ask whether the railway clock had been repaired.
Oskar Urfavv of the Concord shouted a joke across the wire at the Chalk Pits. Rafael "Saint" Ogwanga of the Hegemony laughed before remembering not to. Both lines heard it.
Oskar Urfavv (Concord) and Benedikt "Saint" Thebutcher (Hegemony) watched each other through the same loophole at the Brickworks for an hour. Neither fired. Neither will explain why.

Oskar Urfavv fired at the enemy dawn watch from S-S13. Norbert "Ghost" Ayers was grazed, and the enemy line spent the morning with its heads down. From Blackwater Canal the Hegemony guns have a clear view. Oskar Urfavv wrote to a girl from the dance hall, maybe that night and said only: 'We will take it back.'

Oskar Urfavv fired at a movement across the wire at S-S13. The man went down: Ulrich Nothing, badly wounded. The clerk counted the names twice. Oskar Urfavv is number 501 of the first thousand to answer the call, and wears the ribbon of the First Thousand.
whoa_darryl: Henrik Darryl arrived on Day 10 as a replacement. The men in P-F21 had been fighting for 10 days already and looked at his clean boots like a rumour from another world.
Henrik Darryl found a blank menu card and wrote the evening ration on it in elaborate handwriting. The bread became 'Bread, in the Army Manner'.
xdissonvncex: Henrik "Parson" Xdissonvncex arrived on Day 9 as a replacement. The men in T-F13 had been fighting for 9 days already and looked at his clean boots like a rumour from another world.

The order came down the line: anything that moves. Something moved. Henrik "Parson" Xdissonvncex fired, and Viktor Pauar was grazed. News of the loss of Blackwater Canal reached T-F13 with the rations. Henrik "Parson" Xdissonvncex ate while listening to the revised orders.

Henrik "Parson" Xdissonvncex reached up to fix a sandbag at T-F13 and a bullet took the skin off two knuckles. The sandbag got fixed anyway. Shot by Severin Drowning of the Hegemony (@drowning.in._). Henrik "Parson" Xdissonvncex counted three seconds after the enemy flare went out, then fired at the spot where it had shown a face. Konrad Irl was badly wounded.
